mechanism_narrative: The steady climb in TRANSIT mobility from -34.3 to -31.7 over four weeks signals restored commuting and out-of-home routines; as transit use recovers, retail and recreation footfall follows with a four-week lag.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT continuing to rise or holding above -32.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM crossing into positive territory (+2.1) reflects reduced infection fear and normalised shopping habits; this confidence spills over into discretionary retail spending within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 28 days when GROCERY_PHARM is above 0.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous decline in RESIDENTIAL (from 5.7 to 4.4) and rise in WORKPLACES (from -9.3 to -8.3) indicates a coordinated return to workplaces and outside activity; their interaction multiplies retail footfall over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over next 28 days is not higher than last 28 days when RESIDENTIAL < 5.0 and WORKPLACES > -8.5.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp week-on-week rebound in PARKS from -28.7 to -6.0 signals a surge in outdoor leisure that immediately spills over to nearby retail and recreation establishments within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 15 points week-on-week
failure_condition: In the week after PARKS rises by >15 points, RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the prior week.

mechanism_narrative: The observed seasonal upturn in outdoor mobility, evident in PARKS rising from -19.0 to -6.0 within two weeks, drives open-air retail spending over the next four weeks as weather favours outdoor activity.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 28 days despite PARKS holding above -10.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains below -30, lingering restrictions and fear suppress non-essential retail; persistent transit weakness predicts a decline in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even while TRANSIT stays below -30.

mechanism_narrative: Improving PARKS and falling RESIDENTIAL together indicate people are substituting indoor time for outdoor activity; this behavioural shift lifts retail and recreation footfall over two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days when PARKS is above -15 and RESIDENTIAL is below 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, a renewed fall in TRANSIT below -35 and a rise in RESIDENTIAL above 6 would signal renewed lockdown caution, driving RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days when TRANSIT < -35 and RESIDENTIAL > 6.
